note: expected is written before the capture; observed is what a reviewer saw on opening the file.

scenario.provider: scripts/qa-provider-stub.mjs on loopback, deterministic, no external call
scenario.session: created through session.create, one turn sent through session.prompt

shots.name: wide-01-onboarding
shots.precondition: a first-run dialog is on screen in this Electron profile
shots.expected: the Watch first-run notice: orca mark, the four verbs, an honest readiness count, and two ways out
shots.observed: the Watch notice, with "4 of 12 capabilities are ready" and the consent separation stated below the buttons

shots.name: wide-03-workspace
shots.precondition: the onboarding queue has been cleared
shots.expected: the workspace entered without configuring anything, with the mark and attribution in place
shots.observed: empty workspace, orca mark on the hero and in the sidebar, attribution in the sidebar foot

shots.name: wide-05-mode-chat
shots.precondition: a session that is not blank, and the named tab present in the header
shots.expected: DSH's own conversation view, unchanged, as one tab among seven
shots.observed: a completed turn: prompt, context injections, assistant reply, feedback controls and the turn stats bar

shots.name: wide-05-mode-trajectory
shots.precondition: a session that is not blank, and the named tab present in the header
shots.expected: DSH's own trajectory view, unchanged
shots.observed: the upstream timeline with the turn expanded: system prompt, user, two context injections, assistant

shots.name: wide-05-mode-watch
shots.precondition: a session that is not blank, and the named tab present in the header
shots.expected: the verification surface, with completed and verified kept apart
shots.observed: "Agent completed ≠ Verified" stated; empty state names three ways to get a record

shots.name: wide-05-mode-live
shots.precondition: a session that is not blank, and the named tab present in the header
shots.expected: every source with the permission it would ask for, and nothing started by opening the page
shots.observed: seven sources listed; "Opening this page starts nothing and asks for nothing"; Browser Operator marked as able to act

shots.name: wide-05-mode-memory
shots.precondition: a session that is not blank, and the named tab present in the header
shots.expected: the memory ledger, correctable and with provenance
shots.observed: heading, lead, empty state naming Settings and the agent, and the not-encrypted note

shots.name: wide-05-mode-library
shots.precondition: a session that is not blank, and the named tab present in the header
shots.expected: a working search box over the local index, with filters and index health
shots.observed: search field, Type/Verification/Sort filters, Search and Rebuild index, "0 record(s) indexed"

shots.name: wide-05-mode-compare
shots.precondition: a session that is not blank, and the named tab present in the header
shots.expected: two records side by side, with output differences separate from verification differences
shots.observed: "computed, not reasoned about"; empty state names how to get two records

shots.name: wide-06-settings-general
shots.precondition: the Settings dialog is open
shots.expected: DSH General kept above the Watch sections, unmodified
shots.observed: General, Models, Plugins and Agent presets sit above the seven Watch sections

shots.name: wide-07-settings-roles
shots.precondition: the settings dialog is open at the named section
shots.expected: nine roles, each showing what it is bound to, with unbound stated plainly
shots.observed: per-role cards; every role reads "Nothing bound on this machine", "Last tested: Never"

shots.name: wide-07-settings-engines
shots.precondition: the settings dialog is open at the named section
shots.expected: every engine with runtime, hardware, egress and offline behaviour, and no invented accuracy figure
shots.observed: RapidOCR reads "Measured on this machine"; Tesseract and DeepSeek-OCR read "Not measured on this machine"

shots.name: wide-07-settings-sources
shots.precondition: the settings dialog is open at the named section
shots.expected: every source with the permission it would ask for, and nothing requested by opening the page
shots.observed: all sources "Not requested"; the header states that opening the page requests nothing

shots.name: wide-07-settings-memory-settings
shots.precondition: the settings dialog is open at the named section
shots.expected: the memory scope and retention rules, with the shipped default visible
shots.observed: scope and retention rendered; the manual profile has memory at local_personal

shots.name: wide-07-settings-verification
shots.precondition: the settings dialog is open at the named section
shots.expected: the four verdicts defined, and green reserved for VERIFIED alone
shots.observed: "Agent completed ≠ Verified" leads; all four verdicts defined; green reserved for VERIFIED explicitly

shots.name: wide-07-settings-diagnostics
shots.precondition: the settings dialog is open at the named section
shots.expected: what this installation consists of, saying so where a value cannot be read
shots.observed: 12 capabilities with Ready / Local / Not configured / Not tested — matching the onboarding count of 4

shots.name: wide-07-settings-about
shots.precondition: the settings dialog is open at the named section
shots.expected: versions, the DSH commit, honest attribution, and licences including the weights position
shots.observed: all present; "Model weights: Distributed with none. A code licence is not a weights licence."

shots.name: wide-08-sidebar-collapsed
shots.precondition: the sidebar has been collapsed
shots.expected: the 56px rail with the mark visible and the attribution not reflowed into it
shots.observed: rail correct at 56px, mark and attribution glyph both present — but the Settings dialog stayed open over it, so the shot does not isolate the rail
